product_one_liner.value: Bitly is a link and QR Code management platform that helps businesses and marketers create, share, and track links and QR Codes to measure and improve their online and offline marketing.
product_one_liner.notes: Paraphrased from Bitly's official description of its platform and audience.

pricing_page.notes: Bitly publicly lists plan tiers and prices, including free, paid, and custom enterprise plans.

named_customers.notes: Both are identified in Bitly customer case studies.

employee_band.notes: Bitly's LinkedIn company profile lists the company size as 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: The LinkedIn profile identifies New York, NY as headquarters.

founded_year.notes: Bitly's About page references its founding at Bitly HQ in 2008.

eng_blog.notes: Bitly identifies word.bitly.com as its engineering blog; its posts include engineering architecture and putting Go code into production.

public_docs.notes: The public developer portal includes API reference material, getting-started guides, tutorials, SDK resources, and other documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The official careers page has an Open positions section, but the accessible page content did not show any open job titles or an AI/ML/data-science posting.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed Bitly's developer documentation, AI product pages, trust/security information, and privacy information; none of the accessible material reviewed names the model provider used by the product.

compliance_certs.notes: Bitly's Trust & Safety information says it is SOC 2 compliant and GDPR compliant. The page also mentions Swiss-US Privacy Shield, which is not included because it is not one of the requested items.

last_funding.notes: Bitly's announcement describes a $63 million majority growth investment from Spectrum Equity dated July 12, 2017.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest funding round identified in the funding history is dated July 2017, before the 18-month window beginning May 9, 2025.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The official careers page has an Open positions section, but the accessible page content did not show any current SDR, BDR, or account executive posting.

launched_6mo.notes: On October 20, 2026, Bitly announced its GPT as a ChatGPT plugin, bringing link and QR Code creation and performance analytics into ChatGPT; this falls within the six months before the run date.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Bitly announced Matt Young's appointment as CTO on March 19, 2026, within the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: These systems are visibly named in Bitly's integrations directory. This records visible integration signals, not confirmation of Bitly's internal CRM stack.
